a3-b154: The ZHoly3O ferment contains more than just fermented beet juice, but you can ferment your own beet juice or even use other ferments. I found fermented beet made with apple vinegar and salt was best so far, though kimchi and kombucha also helped. Most yogurts weren't fermented enough to work, and apple vinegar by itself only helped a little. Smelling the ferment helps a lot, and drinking a spoonful can also help, although it may cause itching in somebody who breaks down histamine poorly, which then requires activated charcoal to reduce gut histamine.
a2-b156: For my ozonated zeolite, I mix the powder into water and use an ozone-water purifier in a glass vessel because ozone destroys plastic, and I mean ozonating water, never inhaling ozone gas. With a machine producing about two grams of ozone per hour, ten minutes produced a working zeolite for me, however much zeolite was in the water. Less time didn't work as well, and going past ten minutes didn't noticeably improve the zeolite.
a6-b156-b157:
For my ozonated zeolite, I mix the powder into water and use an ozone-water purifier in a glass vessel because ozone destroys plastic, and I mean ozonating water, never inhaling ozone gas. With a machine producing about two grams of ozone per hour, ten minutes produced a working zeolite for me, however much zeolite was in the water. Less time didn't work as well, and going past ten minutes didn't noticeably improve the zeolite.

Zeolite binds metals, which is part of why it is used for heavy-metal removal, so I don't put it into a metal thing or use a metal spoon. I use glass for ozonating and storing it whenever I can.
